explanation: Under a microscope he saw that the burrs carried tiny hooks that caught loops of fur. The name Velcro joins the French velours, velvet, and crochet, hook.

claims.text: George de Mestral invented Velcro after noticing burdock burrs clinging to his dog's fur.
De Mestral's inspiration was not pine needles, thistle down or grass seeds.
Under a microscope, burdock burrs show tiny hooks that catch on loops of fur or fabric.
The name Velcro comes from the French words velours, velvet, and crochet, hook.
